info.title: Model Info
info.sizeUnavailable: Size unavailable — model was loaded from the OPFS cache. Reload from disk to see file size.

sizeTip.normal: Typical IFC file. Good performance on modern hardware.
sizeTip.large: Large file. Loading may take longer. OPFS cache will help on repeat opens.
sizeTip.heavy: Very large file. Consider splitting the model or using LOD techniques for better performance.

elementTip.complex: Complex model. Interaction may feel slower on lower-end GPUs.
elementTip.dense: Extremely dense model. Consider LOD or splitting by discipline.

rendererTip.webgpu: WebGPU renderer active — maximum performance available on this device.
rendererTip.webgl: WebGL renderer. WebGPU is not available in this browser.

itops.label: Office IT · live
itops.allOkLine: 12 Wi-Fi points, racks, UPS, camera and badge reader report every 5 s. The next fault shows here, red, with its room.

kind.badge: {{value}} failed badge attempts at the door

itops.withoutLine: A user calls. Someone drives over to find the fault. Hours of downtime.
itops.withLine: Alert in {{s}} s with the exact room. Fixed remotely, often before anyone notices.
itops.howText: An office of {{staff}} people at a loaded {{rate}} an hour. A year: 2 server-room heat events (≈2 h with the office stopped), 12 Wi-Fi outages (one room for 1 h plus a site visit) and 3 failed backups (a day of work redone). The demo compresses a month of faults into minutes.

live.title: This office reports itself
live.text: Every Wi-Fi point, rack, UPS, camera and badge reader sends its state every 5 seconds and paints itself on the 3D plan. Green is fine. Red is a problem, in the room where it happens.

server.title: The server room, before it fails
server.text: Right now: {value} °C. Above 27 °C it turns red and you get an alert in seconds, before the servers throttle and 25 people stop working.

wifi.title: Every access point, every room
wifi.text: {value} devices on this one right now. When a point drops you see which room, before the first complaint call, and fix it without a site visit.

security.title: Doors and cameras on the same screen
security.text: Failed badge attempts in the last 5 minutes: {value}. Repeated failures raise an alert at the door they happen at, next to the camera that sees it.

value.title: What it's worth
value.text: Without the twin a fault takes hours to notice and a trip to fix. With it: 10 seconds, the exact room, often fixed remotely. Around €12,000 a year for one office; multiply by your clients' sites. In the browser, from your own IFC, no hardware to install.
